FINAL SQL:
SELECT e.Name
FROM employee e
JOIN (
    SELECT Employee_ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM evaluation
    GROUP BY Employee_ID
) ev ON e.Employee_ID = ev.Employee_ID
WHERE ev.cnt = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM evaluation
        GROUP BY Employee_ID
    )
);
